title: Move weekend deadlines to the next business day (Rule 0-3)
author: Anya
summary: Rule 0-3 says that when a filing deadline falls on a Saturday, Sunday or federal holiday, the filing is on time if it's made the next business day. The pipeline counts calendar days only, so a company that files on the Monday after a Saturday or Sunday deadline is wrongly labelled 'Filed after extension'.
changes: int_extension_deadlines keeps the calendar deadline as calendar_deadline and moves a Saturday or Sunday deadline to the following Monday.
Updates the expectation in 'NT 10-Q deadline crosses a month end': 2025-02-02 is a Sunday, so the deadline is now 2025-02-03.
Adds two unit tests, a Saturday deadline and a weekday deadline, and a data test that no deadline falls on a weekend.
Federal holidays are out of scope. They need a holiday calendar table, which would be a separate change.

modifiedTests.name: NT 10-Q deadline crosses a month end

test.name: Saturday deadline moves to Monday
test.why: Oct 26 2026 + 5 days is Saturday Oct 31. Rule 0-3 moves it to Monday Nov 2.

test.name: Weekday deadline is unchanged
test.why: The change should only touch weekend deadlines.

test.name: No deadline falls on a weekend
test.sql: SELECT * FROM int_extension_deadlines WHERE strftime('%w', deadline) IN ('0', '6')

expectedDataFailures: Matches the published report, row by row
checklist: The rule is cited and the scope (weekends, not holidays) is stated.
Every changed test expectation has a reason.
New tests cover both sides of the change (weekend moves, weekday doesn't).
The output diff only contains the rows the change should move.
Failing reconciliation is expected: the published report still uses calendar days until this merges.
